spans.s:
उज्जृम्भ् उज्-जृम्भ् (उद्-जृम्भ्), cl. 1. A.,
poet. P. -जृम्भते, -ति, -भितुम्, to gape, to open;
to part asunder; to show one's self, become visible,
come forth, break forth, expand, arise.

उज्-जृम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, gaping, parting asunder,
open, apart; blown, expanded.

उज्-जृम्भण, अम्, n. the act of gaping, opening
the mouth.

उज्-जृम्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, stretched; ex-
panded, blown; (अम्), n. effort, exertion.
